caption:
106,656 people rated this mattress protector. Almost none mention leaks.

That review count is not normal for a bedding accessory. It means a huge number of full-size beds are already running this waterproof layer underneath the sheets, night after night. A number that size only holds up at 4.5 stars if the protector is actually doing its job.

It's a 200 GSM waterproof mattress protector built to fit full-size mattresses up to 15 inches deep, designed to stay soft and breathable instead of feeling like plastic. 106,656 reviews at a 4.5-star average is the kind of sample size that filters out lucky first impressions.

For a full-size bed, it's a low-effort way to keep spills, sweat, and accidents off the actual mattress. It's $19.99.
